name: jvmscope
description: Local Java thread-dump, TLS and garbage-collection log analysis with JvmScope's shared engines and knowledge base.

interface.longDescription: Analyze user-selected Java thread dumps, SunJSSE TLS logs and HotSpot GC logs locally. Thread reports include optional interactive deadlock graphs and source evidence on MCP Apps-compatible hosts. Requires Node.js 22 or later. Tool results are shared with the connected AI host; local parsing is not offline AI.
defaultPrompt: Try the bundled Java deadlock example and show its interactive report.
Explain why this TLS handshake failed.
Analyze this GC log and identify long pauses.
